citations.assessment: The father of Rav Safra asks R. Zeira about tying coins into garments of different materials. The Yerushalmi writes Safra where Heilprin has Tzafra.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: The specific Yuhasin aleph lemma remains open. The Yerushalmi source does attest the father designation in the reported question.
